style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, satirical, hard noon sun over a seaside market
motion_rule: she works from a crate of crushed ice on a stone counter and never travels anywhere; the camera orbits her in EVERY beat and reverses the orbit at 0.82, 2.46, 4.71 and 6.76, so crates, lemons and hooks sweep past behind her; a gull, an ice chunk or a cook arm wipes the lens every beat; she works fins, tail and mouth in EVERY beat; she fills half the frame height; new shot size each beat; one action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a plump red mullet, rose and gold scales, two long barbels under her chin, upright on her tail
second_characters: ONE cook in a white apron lunging at the lens across the crate all clip; A SWARM of gulls diving through the lens in every beat
props: ONE paper tag she rips off her own flank at 0.0 and hurls at 1.64; ONE tin bucket of ice in the cook hands; ONE brass scale pan swinging on a hook; ONE glass cloche in the cook hands from 8.6; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the torn tag is hers until she hurls it, then the gulls carry it; the bucket, the pan and the cloche are never hers
environment: a noon bright seaside fish market packed with crates, crushed ice, hanging lemons, brass hooks, awnings, the sea behind

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: bright chesty female voice, wounded pride, even 4.9 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ye-SCHO, vche-RA, STO-i-la, smesh-NYKH, DE-neg, me-NYU, ROS-koshj, ko-TO-ru-yu, poz-VO-lit
audio.pacing: 0.0-2.46 one breath, a short breath at 2.46, 2.46-7.38 one breath; after 7.38 not a word, only sfx
audio.lip_sync: her mouth opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: market din all clip, gull cries, ice crunching, paper tearing at 0.0, a wet tail slap at 6.76, glass ringing at 8.6

timeline.a: she rips the paper tag off her own flank, big in frame, gulls tearing across behind her
she waves the torn tag wide across the lens, the cook lunging past her shoulder
she hurls the tag into the lens, gulls tearing after it as the camera whips the other way
she rears up as the cook slams the bucket down beside her, ice bursting across the lens
she throws her fins wide and a curtain of hanging lemons swings into the lens
she hammers her tail into the ice, chips spraying past the lens
she bats the brass pan and it sweeps across the lens
she snaps at a gull diving through the frame
she slaps her tail at the lens, ice bursting into the glass
she flicks her barbels at the lens, gulls tearing both ways, the cook grabbing at her from the side
the cook lowers a glass cloche over her and she hammers the glass from inside at the lens, gulls smacking into it, the camera still circling

must_appear: she stays in her crate of ice the whole clip; at 2.46 the bucket bursts ice across the lens beside her; at 6.76 she slaps her tail at the lens; at 8.60 the cloche comes down and she hammers the glass from inside
negative_prompt: conveyor belt, moving walkway, cart, rail, a hero riding anything, speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, latin letters, printed words on props, digits, letterbox, night, dark scene, a parked camera, a still background, a distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, a hero lying flat on the ice, speech after 7.38
